name: BMW
look: Light canvas with dark navy only inside hero bands, corporate blue as the single action colour, and rectangular zero-radius buttons.

hero.title: Sheer driving pleasure
hero.sub: A rear-biased chassis, a straight-six that revs to seven thousand, and an interior designed around the person actually steering.

features.title: Balance before power
features.sub: Weight distribution, steering feel and body control decide whether a car is enjoyable. Power only decides how quickly it gets boring.

items.title: 50:50 distribution
items.body: Achieved by placing the drivetrain rather than by adding ballast to compensate.

items.title: Steering feel
items.body: Hydraulic assistance retained on the driver's package, because the electric system loses information.

items.title: Straight-six
items.body: Inherently balanced, revving to seven thousand, with the induction audible rather than synthesised.

items.title: Adaptive chassis
items.body: Dampers reading the road every two milliseconds, with a comfort setting that is genuinely comfortable.

items.title: Electric option
items.body: The same chassis philosophy with a rear motor and a 620 kilometre range.

items.title: Five-star safety
items.body: Structural design rather than assistance systems doing the work in a real impact.

showcases.title: The same car, differently powered
showcases.body: The electric variant shares the chassis, the steering and the seating position. It is the same car with a different power source rather than a separate product built to a different brief.
points: 620 km range on the combined cycle
350 kW charging to 80 percent in 22 minutes

showcases.title: Service that comes to you
showcases.body: Scheduled servicing collected from an address of your choosing, with a courtesy vehicle and an itemised report including photographs of anything replaced.

testimonial.quote: I drove the electric one expecting to be disappointed and could not tell the difference through a corner. That is the whole engineering argument, demonstrated.
testimonial.name: Klaus Reinhardt

pricing.title: CONFIGURE
pricing.sub: Three specifications. Delivery from twelve weeks.

items.a: Because electric assistance filters out surface information the driver uses. It is retained on the driver's package where that feedback is the point.

items.q: Is the electric version a different car?
items.a: No. Same chassis, same steering geometry, same seating position. The battery placement preserves the weight distribution rather than compromising it.
From twelve weeks for a standard specification. Configured orders are given a build slot at the point of order rather than an estimate.

cta.title: CONFIGURE YOURS

notes: The light canvas is the base surface; dark navy appears only inside hero bands. The page rhythm relies on that contrast.
Corporate blue is the single primary action colour throughout.
The typographic signature is weight 700 display against weight 300 body — a wide gap held consistently.
Buttons are rectangular at 0px radius. That corporate dialect is what distinguishes it from the sportier M sub-brand.
Model cards run four or five up with no hairline border — just a white plate, the photograph and the title.
